source_observations.text: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.
Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.

primary_reviews.support: Hebrew-textual observation: First-person bodily response returns at 3:16; the deprivation concession at 3:17 meets yet-rejoicing at 3:18 and strength, deer-foot movement, and musical subscription at 3:19.
primary_reviews.counterevidence: The first-person return, concessive marker, emphatic response, and subscription are real internal turns.
